title: E-Commerce Marketplace Analytics
thesis: Snowflake powers marketplace intelligence — Dynamic Tables maintain real-time GMV and seller performance, ML.FORECAST projects seasonal demand, and Cortex AI generates personalized seller growth recommendations

talking_points: Rp 120 trillion annual GMV from 500,000 sellers and 10 million active buyers.
GMV growing 28% YoY — electronics and fashion driving 55% of volume.
Harbolnas 12.12 projected at Rp 18 trillion — biggest single event.
show: Point at Rp 120T GMV and 28% growth
tabs.call_out: Rp 120T GMV, 28% growth — Harbolnas 12.12 projected at Rp 18T

transition.line: Let's look at seller performance driving this growth.

talking_points: 500,000 sellers segmented into 4 tiers — top 2% generate 45% of GMV.
ML identifies 3,200 high-value sellers at elevated churn risk.
Category trends: health & beauty up 42%, electronics flat, fashion recovering.
show: Show seller tier distribution and GMV contribution
tabs.call_out: 3,200 high-value sellers at churn risk — Rp 8.4T GMV at stake

transition.line: Seller retention is critical. Let's see campaign performance.

talking_points: 10,000 campaigns analyzed — average ROI at 2.8x incremental GMV.
ML.FORECAST models seasonal demand to optimize discount depth and timing.
Flash sales: 3.5x GMV multiplier vs baseline, but margin compression at 12%.
show: Point at flash sale GMV vs margin trade-off
tabs.call_out: ML optimizes 12.12 planning — 3.5x GMV multiplier achievable at 8% margin

transition.line: Now let the VP ask about marketplace health.

talking_points: Kevin asks: 'What's our GMV run-rate this quarter?'
Cortex Analyst queries order data — returns Rp 32T with 28% growth trajectory.
Follow-up: 'Generate retention strategy for churning high-value sellers' — AI produces plan.
show: Switch to advisory mode for strategy
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: marketplace analytics + strategic advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, native ML.

Indonesia's e-commerce market: US$82B — largest in Southeast Asia.
50 million orders processed per month at peak.
show: Point at real-time order data flow

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for e-commerce.
